career_ladder.note: Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB), a Central Armed Police Force under the Ministry of Home Affairs, guards India's international borders with Nepal and Bhutan. The Non-GD technical and tradesman cadres provide vital communication, mechanical, electrical, veterinary, and logistical support to border outposts. Personnel advance through the subordinate technical ranks to Assistant Sub-Inspector, Sub-Inspector, Inspector, and Group 'A' Gazetted specialist officer cadres.

exam_scheme.note: The selection process for SSB Head Constable (Non-GD / Technical) consists of four sequential stages: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST) (qualifying nature); Common Entrance Test (CET / Written Exam) comprising 150 questions for 150 marks in 3 hours; Skill Test / Trade Test (qualifying nature, 50 marks); and Document Verification with Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME).

Qualifying (Height 170 cm male, 157 cm female; Chest 80-85 cm male, with prescribed relaxations)

financial_package.pay_source_label: SSB — Recruitment Notice, Pay Scale for Head Constable (Level 4)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 4 entry basic pay (₹25,500) for Head Constable with 58% DA (₹14,790), Ration Money Allowance (RMA, ₹3,900/mo), Transport Allowance, and Border Outpost / Difficult Area Allowance where deployed. For Constable (Tradesman) posts at Level 3 (₹21,700 basic), monthly gross salary ranges from ₹38,000 to ₹49,000 with in-hand pay between ₹33,000 and ₹43,000.
official_perks: Ration Money Allowance (RMA) / Free Government Messing (approx. ₹3,900/month)
Border Outpost / Risk and Hardship Allowance for deployed international border units
Free medical coverage in SSB and CAPF Composite Hospitals across India
Subsidized Central Police Canteen (CPC) purchasing privileges
Defined contribution retirement benefits under National Pension System (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: SSB conducts specialized recruitment drives for non-GD technical cadres and tradesmen. In the 2026 recruitment drive, 233 vacancies were advertised for Head Constable (Communication: 197, Electrician: 29, Veterinary: 5, Steward: 2) alongside 827 Constable Tradesman vacancies. In the 2023 drive, 914 Head Constable vacancies were notified across specialized trades.
